definitions.gloss: silver screen; the movies; the cinema world
definitions.explanation: A literary word for the movie screen, and by extension the world of cinema. Often used when speaking of film as a glamorous art form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銀幕|ぎんまく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スター→スター：00393_sutaa⟧だった。
examples.english: She was a star of the silver screen.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{銀幕|ぎんまく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きた。
examples.english: That actor returned to the silver screen after a long absence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銀幕|ぎんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{彩|いろど}った→彩る：12542_irodoru⟧{名優|めいゆう}たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw an exhibition of the great actors who graced the silver screen of the Showa era.

notes:
Literally "silver curtain." Early movie screens had a silvery, reflective surface, which gave rise to the name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀幕|ぎんまく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スター→スター：00393_sutaa⟧: a star of the silver screen
- {銀幕|ぎんまく}⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧: a film debut
- {銀幕|ぎんまく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to grace the screen

USAGE:
{銀幕|ぎんまく} is a somewhat literary, nostalgic word, used most often for classic cinema. For everyday talk about movies, ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧ is the normal word.
